description: The Bureau of National Statistics of Kazakhstan publishes the results of the 2021 National Population Census as thematic volumes, several in English, and dashboards. The volume on housing characteristics has 13 tables. Its table 5 counts households by type of dwelling (single family house, apartment building, dormitory, dacha and others) and by each type of improvement: electricity, network or bottled gas, central heating or stove heating by fuel, water supply inside the dwelling or from a standpipe, flush toilet, central or other sewerage, central or individual hot water, garbage collection, telephone, fixed or mobile internet and television, for the country and for urban and rural settlements. Other tables give period of construction, rooms, ownership and floor area, and the number of households by premises type for each region and city. Coverage is national: of 5,611,253 households, 2,832,754 had network gas, 2,644,224 central heating, 2,406,672 central sewerage and 461,034 a fixed internet connection. Format and access: free PDF download, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the utility table is not broken down by region; 58.7% of households gave no construction period. Simulation uses: national shares of gas, district heat, sewer and internet connection by dwelling type for energy and network demand models. Related records: the Georgia census 2024 dwelling facilities tables and the Estonia REL2021 dwelling amenities tables.
